featured_reviews.name: Stephen Sodder
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shahari bhandar  Bandra West is good i have been their customer since years........but their quality of staff service is not good at all......staff is not friendly.....neither they can solve a query.....they offer discounts ....but one needs to check their bill thoroughly as they sometimes don't really initiate the discount while punching the order.....so one has to attentive .....
Like i had visited the store on 2nd of April and shopped for a total bill of 7,000/- which included a offer mentioning Kinley Soda buy 3 get one free .....so i picked up 12 and they charged me for all 12 instead of the order that mentioned by 3 get one free.....when I reviewed the bill after a couple of days ......I noticed that the offer that they had mentioned they had not initiated the offer and inturn charged me for all 12 bottles of kinley  Soda.......when i visited them next after a  week .......I notified the help desk ....Mr. Shaziya Ansari was attending it...and she after a 10 minute discussion put me on to Mrs. Kirti....after discussing about the same for another 10 minute I requested her if i could have a word with their Supervisor Mr. Hanmanth More.......he tried to confuse me with giving some irrelevant explanation saying the discount given was in percentage....so it's not seen in the bill but they have offers the discount which he badly failed to prove as we had paid the whole amount for 12 kinley Soda......without any discount ....so after a discussion of another 20 mins....the supervisor called out another staff to settle the matter n left....and the staff that he mentioned never turned up to the Help desk counter.......after waiting for over all 45 mins.......we got fed up with their service and left the store......so we have decided not to visit the store anymore....as they are cheating in the name of offers n discounts.....and when they are caught .....they just waste the customers time by putting up different people to handle the situation....and wate time so the customers get fed up n leave the store disappointed......but I just got to inform the other customers to be aware ...whole billing and not to fall for their discounts n offers...and ti check their bills thoroughly bfr leaving the store....as later when u realize that you have been cheated.......it too late.....
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Stephen, please accept our sincerest apologies that we didn’t live up to your expectations on this occasion. We're thankful that you reached out to share your experience as your valuable feedback helps us to better serve our clients. Please reach out to us at customerservice@ril.com to discuss how we can make this right.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best known gourmet grocery store - Nature's Basket, has its branch located on Hill Road, Bandra. It is one of the best stores for gourmet grocery, fresh produces, bakery, meat and desserts.

They have large range of varieties when it comes to cheese and meat. Variety of fresh fish is also available.

Cold cuts of chicken, lamb, pork and turkey is also available. One should definitely check the dates though before buying.

The staff is polite and friendly. They also have vast range of beer and wine collection.

Now with Christmas round the corner, they have lot of Christmas varieties and delicacies. A beautiful  Christmas tree adds its charm to this beautiful store.

Tip: It is better to check the expiry dates for cold cuts and bakery products before buying. Sometimes the products are close to expiry.

Nature's Basket also started serving sushi.

name: Foodstories Hill Road
description:
Foodstories is a gourmet food destination in Bandra West, Mumbai, curated for those who appreciate exceptional ingredients and thoughtful flavours. From premium fresh produce to artisanal cheeses, fine pantry essentials, and global delicacies, every product is selected with care.

At Foodstories, we believe food is a story that is discovered, created, and shared. We also specialise in curated gourmet gifting, offering thoughtfully designed hampers and personalised gift solutions for every occasion.

Located in the heart of Bandra, our store is built for the curious, home cooks, and food lovers, bringing a unique gourmet experience to Mumbai.

owner_posts.post_text:
Oyster Mushrooms from Uttarakhand 🍄

Freshly harvested from the hills of Uttarakhand, our Oyster Mushrooms are prized for their delicate texture, mild savoury flavour, and incredible versatility in the kitchen. Rich in fibre and naturally packed with nutrients, they make a wholesome addition to stir-fries, soups, pasta, and gourmet dishes. Bring home farm-fresh goodness and elevate your everyday cooking with premium produce from Foodstories.

Plums from South Africa 🍑

featured_reviews.name: Anita Vardhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Terrible Quality & Zero Accountability
I am incredibly disappointed with my recent experience at this store. I bought a melon and placed a pickup order for mangoes, and both were completely unacceptable.
The Melon: On the outside, it looked perfectly raw and fresh. However, when I cut it open, the seeds inside had actually sprouted. For seeds to germinate inside a fruit, it has to be incredibly old. It’s alarming that something this aged was sitting on their shelves.
The Mangoes: I ordered these for pickup, and they were completely squashed and of awful quality.
To make matters worse, when I called the store to report this, the staff member tried to excuse it by telling me their team "wasn't trained." Instead of apologizing and checking the quality of the products currently on their shelves, they chose to justify their mistakes.
If your staff doesn't know how to inspect quality, pack orders, or handle a basic pickup, you shouldn't be offering the service. You simply cannot trust the freshness or the service here.
Save your money and shop elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: Gita AM
featured_reviews.review_text: Mahima Stores (Mangalore Store) on Hill Road  is a popular Bandra institution.  Its been there for atleast 30 years if not longer and all old Bandra-ites will have been there multiple times.  Originally these 'Mangalore Stores' found in several localities were where you could find typical south Indian foodstuff.  Today with online shopping and diverse foods available at every food store, one doesnt need to go to a speciality south Indian shop.  But Mahima is much more than just an old fashioned, homely Mangalore store.   It isnt fancy looking and its a small space chock full of various foods, but ask for just about any food item and  the friendly staff shall give it to you in a jiffy.   Speciality Mangalore and other south Indian items are ofcourse available too, along with freshly cooked ready to eat items, bread, sweets, snacks, masalas and what have you.   Visit once and you will definitely be drawn back again and again and again.  Three Cheers for Bandra's Mahima Stores!

featured_reviews.review_text: Fatima cold storage products are very very fresh delivered to your doorstep... Super duper stuff. Have been one of their very early customer and still continue to be one..very kind and warm people... Thank you Fatima cold storage.. Keep going and all the best..

featured_reviews.name: Scooby Doobey
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent for  authentic goan rosary sausages from  Margao.  Frsh chicken.  Good value for money. Busy on Novena days.. but Home delivery is very convenient.  No khich khich about card payments. Accepts paytm :). Has Goa vinegar and seafood,  crabsticks, etc also. Can customize order unlike others.  Staff are prompt. 👌

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Bakshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Organized, Customized, and genuinely interested in the customer experience. Fatima and her staff really take attention to detail, and make the whole gamut of buying meat what it should become. Where larger stores have failed to succeed, Fatima makes it a Personalized Boutique experience for everyone who knocks on her door.

U just gotta try once to become addicted...

featured_reviews.name: David Zuzarte
featured_reviews.review_text: A friend told me about Fatima Cold Storage while passing. So we parked and went in to purchase some meat. Tried it and was amazed. Simply the best service - meat was superb, amazing quality cuts of meat, a great selection, and well worth the cost. They have meats for every budget and the store is open on Monday's too! Which is awesome because that's my grocery shopping day and you can't beat the fact that it is locally owned and family operated. The store is street facing but is still spotless and clean. The owners are extremely helpful, polite and friendly. I wasn't pressured or rushed when making my selections. They have a wide variety of meats and great prices. The meat is beautiful and I have always received much more than what I've expected - quality and taste wise. This store always exceeds my expectations and it never ceases to amaze me how tasty the meat is. I will definitely be back when I have room in deep freezer. I can't say enough great things about this place and I don't even live in the same locality that it's located in. That's how you know I enjoy my meats from this shop. To bridge the gap, I was offered the option of home-delivery. I have now placed quite a few orders with them and I can say that I will never buy at the local market (bazaar) again. I've ordered many times and the quality of the meat has been consistently great. I've mostly bought the better cuts and the flavour has been outstanding. Really been very impressed. Its arrived on time and the staff has been very good to deal with. The insulated box they deliver it in to keep the meat cold is...well, really cool!!

featured_reviews.name: Robin Abraham
featured_reviews.review_text: The best meat shop in the locality. What makes it even more endearing is their ability to go out of the way to make it convenient for you. The range of options in terms of cuts and preparations is wide and so is their patience to explain what you are buying. The icing on the cake is however, their amazing knack of remembering what you ordered the last time around and checking whether it was upto expectations. That's stellar customer service. Once you are their customer, you don't even think of an option.

featured_reviews.name: Beverly Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: This is THE BEST shop in town for meats and meat products. They have the freshest and tastiest stuff - be it raw meats or the processed foods. I highly recommend them for their hygiene, quality of food, efficient service, prompt deliveries, friendly owners, payment options, tech-savvy approach and most of all the variety of products available to prepare a wholesome meal! It's always a delight to shop with them and stock up the freezer with meats for every meal of the day. If you crave meat as much as me, then this is the place to tickle your taste buds!
